articles.title: Datasentre i Norge kan nesten tredoble sitt strømforbruk
articles.author: Erlend Tro Klette
key_facts: 104 data centers in operation in Norway as of 2026-03-20 (Nkom)
Norwegian data centers consumed 2.1 TWh in 2024, 1.2% of national power production
NVE projects 6 TWh by 2030 if known/decided projects realize
3,400 MW grid capacity reserved by data centers (20-30 TWh/yr at full uptake)
Reserved capacity ~ 50-75% of all Norwegian household electricity (40.9 TWh in 2024)
Increase from 2024 to 2030 (~3.9 TWh) ≈ household consumption of Bergen + Trondheim + Tromsø combined

articles.title: Liste over kommersielle datasenteroperatørar (2026-03-20)
key_facts: 55 commercial data center operators registered under datasenterforskrift
104 data centers in total operation (incl. captive/internal sites)
8 operators flagged for cryptocurrency mining (>0% of consumption)
